scope: Read-only Cloudflare Workers aggregate CPU analytics for disposable transport probes. This query does not measure garbling CPU or per-operation cost.
limits: One-second buckets can combine multiple transfer sizes, paths, and concurrent requests. Do not combine bucket quantiles into a campaign quantile.
The query includes both hosted probe campaigns within this time window.
Durable Object CPU attribution and per-operation billing are not established by this aggregate Worker dataset.
units: microseconds for all cpuTime and wallTime fields
